characters.name: 좀비1_일반좀비
characters.design: Normal-sized adult HUMAN-SHAPED ZOMBIE made of mint/lime translucent slime material. Human anatomical silhouette: smaller normal human head with recognizable brow/nose/ears/jaw, neck, narrow adult torso and pelvis, two long upper arms/forearms with elbows/wrists and human-shaped hands/fingers, two long thighs/shins with knees/ankles and human-shaped feet. Slightly hunched zombie posture. Adult proportions about5.5heads tall, NOT a large round head or small jelly/blob mascot. Wet surface highlights and few internal bubbles; no actual human inside, no bones or gore.

characters.name: 좀비2_큰좀비
characters.design: A LARGE HUMAN-SHAPED ZOMBIE made of thick dark moss/olive slime material. A tall broad heavy adult human build: human-sized head with brow/nose/ears/jaw, clear neck/shoulders/chest/belly/pelvis, two massive upper arms/forearms with elbows and hands/fingers, two thick thighs/shins with knees and feet. One forearm heavier, but preserve human joints/anatomy and two-legged silhouette. Dense layered gelatin, amber internal nucleus, broad highlights. Much larger in mass than normal human slime zombie. Not a blob, tentacle creature, oversized-head mascot, actual person inside, or boss.

characters.name: 슬라임을 뒤집어쓴 일반 사람
characters.design: An ordinary living adult civilian human, normal proportions, short brown hair, mustard casual sweatshirt, navy trousers, cream/white sneakers. Turquoise/cyan slime is draped OVER the still-visible fully clothed person, hanging from one side of the head, shoulders, forearms and torso; clear warm human face, anxious expressive eyes, one bare hand visible. Slime is a separate coating, NOT the person's flesh. No special profession/uniform/weapon or gore. The person looks frightened and pulled involuntarily by the coating, readable as somebody to rescue.

user_clarification: Slime MATERIAL / HUMAN ZOMBIE ANATOMY; rescue humans are actual people covered by slime
